name: null-lifetime-written-null
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): packs/dtn-bpv7/pack.def and pack.md; RFC 9171 4.1 (bundle), 4.3.1 (primary block), 4.3.2 (canonical block), 4.2.1 (CRC); null (f6) at [0].[7]: bpv7.lifetime_ms is absent (Transforms: simple value 22 is absent; ruling 6). On write [0].[7] is below the highest present position [0].[8] (the CRC) and no line walks into it as a container: f6 (Writing step 3, ruling 23). So the primary block, and its CRC-16 5d62 computed over the f6, come back unchanged. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
